adaptations.reason: Linux has no original-preload execution; implements window.jmd IPC calls, pure basename/resolveAsset and event listeners. IPC dispatch stays runtime/MoonBit-owned; Ctrl+S is handled by the native menu accelerator, not a page binding.
jmd reads nativeTheme.shouldUseDarkColors at window creation; the adapted facade returns false and exposes inert listener methods.
Bounded polling for fs.watch (250 ms), fs.watchFile/unwatchFile (250..60000 ms), and recursive fs.watch (4096-entry snapshot, change/rename event types). No native inotify claim.
jmd can open a path through loadFile options.query; values are encoded deterministically and the app scheme accepts a query.
ELECTRON_MBT_TEST_MESSAGE_BOX=0..2 returns a deterministic response. Without it showMessageBox stays typed unsupported; there is no destructive default.

Linux host get-primary-display/get-all-displays use GDK monitor geometry; prelude getAllDisplays/getDisplayNearestPoint/getDisplayMatching select by containment/intersection with a documented fallback.
CLI-only test:menu-save hook sends the same menu:save topic the native Save item sends; the native GtkMenuBar is installed separately.
Menu.setApplicationMenu serializes a bounded template; the Linux host installs a real GtkMenuBar and dispatches menu-click ids back to the app's own click handlers. Role items are display-only.
CmdOrCtrl accelerators are mapped to GTK/WebView key handling so Ctrl+S reaches the menu item's click handler; no page Ctrl+S binding remains.
Bounded http(s) GET/HEAD via libsoup, 512 KiB body cap, 5 s timeout, no redirects/credentials. net.request remains unsupported.
ELECTRON_MBT_TEST_DISPLAYS injects up to eight displays only when ELECTRON_MBT_TEST_MODE=1; hardware multi-monitor remains NOT RUN.

note: Pinned jmd 0.2.3 boots the real renderer, opens a markdown document through the test-injected native dialog, renders the marker and a relative image, edits and saves through the real Ctrl+S/menu accelerator, reloads after an external rewrite, installs a native GTK menu, and exercises net.fetch and two-display selection via test injection. Original preload NOT_EXECUTED; compatible:false; macOS out of scope.
